guarantees.claim: At the start of the always_comb block, done_state_d is assigned done_state_q and hash_done_event is assigned 8'd0 by default.
In state DoneAwaitCmd, cool_down_ct_d is set to 8'd0.
In state DoneAwaitCmd, if the compile-time constant sha_hash_process is true, done_state_d transitions to DoneAwaitHashDone.
In state DoneAwaitCmd, if sha_hash_process is false and reg_hash_stop is asserted, done_state_d transitions to DoneAwaitMessageComplete.
guarantees.cond: done_state_q == DoneAwaitCmd and sha_hash_process == false and reg_hash_stop == 1

guarantees.claim: In state DoneAwaitHashDone, if reg_hash_done is asserted, hash_done_event is set to 1'b1 and done_state_d transitions to DoneAwaitCmd.
In state DoneAwaitMessageComplete, if digest_on_blk is asserted, done_state_d transitions to DoneAwaitHashComplete.

In state DoneAwaitHashComplete, if hash_running is deasserted and cool_down_ct_q is less than 127, then cool_down_ct_d is incremented by 1, hash_done_event is kept at 0, and done_state_d remains DoneAwaitHashComplete.
In state DoneAwaitHashComplete, if hash_running is deasserted and cool_down_ct_q is at least 127, hash_done_event is set to 1'b1 and done_state_d transitions to DoneAwaitCmd.
In states DoneAwaitHashDone, DoneAwaitMessageComplete, and the implicit default branch, cool_down_ct_d is not assigned within this block, causing it to retain its previous value (latch inference).

assumptions.claim: done_state_q must always hold one of the defined enumeration values (DoneAwaitCmd, DoneAwaitHashDone, DoneAwaitMessageComplete, DoneAwaitHashComplete).
assumptions.risk: If done_state_q takes an undefined value, the default branch leaves done_state_d unchanged and never asserts hash_done_event, causing a permanent stall of the done signaling FSM.

assumptions.claim: cool_down_ct_q must not experience glitches or single-event upsets that jump to a value >= 127 unexpectedly while in state DoneAwaitHashComplete with !hash_running.
assumptions.risk: A bit-flip that pushes cool_down_ct_q to 127 or above will cause immediate transition to DoneAwaitCmd and assertion of hash_done_event, bypassing the intended cool-down period and potentially generating a spurious done event.

assumptions.claim: The combinational inputs reg_hash_done, digest_on_blk, and hash_running must remain stable long enough to be sampled by this combinational block; combinational loops or glitches could cause unintended state transitions.
assumptions.cond: during evaluation of this always_comb block
assumptions.risk: Transient glitches on these signals could cause the state machine to erroneously advance, potentially asserting hash_done_event at the wrong time or entering unknown states.

uncertain_points.claim: The FSM has a default branch that performs no recovery action; if done_state_q ever takes an illegal value (e.g., due to SEU), the state machine will hang with no error indication.
uncertain_points.cond: done_state_q not in {DoneAwaitCmd, DoneAwaitHashDone, DoneAwaitMessageComplete, DoneAwaitHashComplete}
uncertain_points.risk: Permanent deadlock of the HMAC done signaling logic, halting all subsequent hash operations.

uncertain_points.claim: cool_down_ct_d is not assigned in the DoneAwaitHashDone, DoneAwaitMessageComplete, and default branches, making it latch its previous value. This may not be the intended behavior and could hold a stale counter value.
uncertain_points.risk: If cool_down_ct_d is actually required to be reset to a known value in all states, the latched value could cause incorrect cool-down timing or an unexpected hash_done_event when the state eventually reaches DoneAwaitHashComplete.
